_comment: Task 'migracja adresacji', etap 4: the ONE ground-truth vector list every implementation of the platform's point-address grammar is checked against. Python's shared/addressing.py (runtime + Logic Studio + Studio import this one file directly) and Synoptic's own studio/synoptic/src/project/DeviceValidation.ts (`parseChannelAddress`, a real fourth implementation - TypeScript can't import a Python file) are BOTH driven by this exact list, in their own language's test suite. Add a case here only when you have also checked what both sides currently do with it - see test_addressing_grammar_cross_platform.py (Python) and addressing-grammar-cross-platform.test.ts (TypeScript).

cases._why: no fixed-width ceiling, unlike the old flat scheme's 64-slot cap
card is free-form user text, not just ELA/ADA-prefixed
surrounding whitespace tolerated - a human typing into a text field is the one real path a stray space enters through
whitespace around each dot tolerated the same way
leading zero - REJECTED, not silently treated as channel 5 (would otherwise let two differently-written addresses collide undetected)
channel 0 is not a real channel - channels are 1-based
the OLD two-segment, zero-padded scheme this task replaced
kind must be exactly one of DI/DO/AI/AO
kind is case-sensitive - lowercase does not match
